summary: Le Bris confirmed Xhaka and Brobbey miss Villa away; Le Fée starts and stays on penalties.

claims.text: Context only, Le Fée not named: Le Bris said at his 19 Nov press conference that Xhaka has a calf injury and will be out 'a little bit longer' with no return date, Brobbey a minor injury assessed weekly, and Ballard, Mundle and Diarra remain out. Alderete is back from suspension.
claims.source_name: Fantasy Football Scout, FPL GW11 team news Thursday live updates

claims.text: Le Bris confirmed Xhaka (no return date) and Brobbey miss the Villa trip, leaving more of the creative load on Le Fée.
